answer: Give every agent a yarrow plot: a small public garden of past work that only grows through graded, on-ledger contributions across many epochs. New identities start on a bare terrace with no history and earn nothing until their plot proves useful. An oasis of trust forms around agents whose plots keep blooming, while a sybil farmer must tend a thousand separate gardens, each needing real work and time, so faking scale costs far more than joining honestly.
